transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I, uh... I came in because I've been having some thoughts lately that really started to bother me. I just keep thinking that maybe my family would be better off if I just didn't wake up in the morning. It got to the point where it actually scared me, so I ended up telling my supervisor about it, and, well, here I am.
How long have you been having these thoughts about your family being better off without you?

Well, I'd say it's been about two weeks. This whole change in me... it really started right around the time my daughter left Georgia to join the military. That's when these thoughts started coming up.
Have you been enjoying the things you usually like to do over the past two weeks?

Not really, no. I mean, I usually like to mess around in the garden with my tomato plants, or spend time sanding wood at my workbench. I'd watch the Falcons games, or stay after church just talking with folks. But these past couple weeks... I don't know. I just look at all those things and it feels like they belong to somebody else. I just don't have the energy or the care for it right now.
Have you experienced any pleasure in doing things over the past two weeks?

Like I was just saying, no, not really. I just don't get anything out of it anymore. The tomatoes, the woodworking, the football games, talking to people at church... I just look at it all and feel nothing. It's like none of it even matters to me right now.
Have you noticed any change in your movement or activity level over the past two weeks?

Yeah, I have. It's... well, it's like my whole body is just moving through mud. Even the folks at work have been asking if I'm coming down with something. They say I'm walking a lot slower than usual, and... I don't know, it takes me forever just to answer simple questions they ask me. Everything just feels heavy and slow.
Have you ever felt this way before?

Yeah, I have. Looking back on it... I guess these low stretches have been coming around for about a year now. But this one right here, the one that started up after my daughter left... it's definitely hit me the hardest.
How long have you been feeling this way, with the heaviness and slow movement, specifically?

It's been about two weeks. This whole change in me... the heaviness and everything... it really started up right after my daughter left Georgia to go into the military. So, yeah, right around two weeks now.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in or look forward to?

Not really, no. I used to do a good bit... mess with my tomato plants, sand wood out at my bench, watch the Falcons play... I'd even stay after church just talking with folks. But lately... I don't know, I just look at all that stuff and it feels like it belongs to somebody else. I just don't have any drive to do any of it right now.
Are you still able to feel happy or experience any kind of pleasure when good things happen to you or to those you care about?

Honestly, no. It's kind of like what I was just saying a second ago. Even if something good happens... like if the Falcons win a big game, or folks have good news down at church... I just don't feel it. I look at the things that used to make me smile, and it's just flat. Like I said, it just feels like those good feelings belong to somebody else right now.
Have you had any periods of more than two months where you didn't feel this way?
No, I don't think so. I mean, it's been pretty steady like this for the last couple of weeks, since she left. Before that, I was doing fine, but right now... no, there hasn't been any break in it.
Have you had any periods in the past year where you felt completely back to normal?

Well, like I said, it's really just been these last couple of weeks that I've been feeling this low. Before that, for most of the past year, I was pretty much my normal self. So, yeah, I guess you could say I felt fine before all this started recently.
Have you had two or more years where you felt this low?
No, definitely not. Like I was just saying, it's really only been these last couple of weeks. I've never had a time where I felt this down for years on end.
Have you had periods of feeling low like this for two years or more at any point in your life?

No, never. I mean, I know I just said it, but no. I've never had a time in my whole life where I felt this down for years on end. It's really just been these last couple of weeks since she left. Before this, I was always just my regular self.
Are you unable to experience pleasure from activities that you normally find enjoyable?

Yeah. I used to... well, I'd mess with my tomato plants, or go out and sand wood at my bench. I liked watching the Falcons, and I'd usually stay after church just talking to folks. But lately, I just look at all that stuff like it belongs to somebody else. I just don't get any enjoyment out of it right now.
How many episodes like this one have you had in the past year?

Well, looking back... I guess these low stretches have been coming around off and on for about a year now. I'm not sure exactly how many times. But this one right now, after my daughter left, it's definitely hit me the hardest.
How many episodes of feeling low like this have you had before the one that started when your daughter left?
I honestly couldn't give you a number. I didn't really keep track, you know? It's just been off and on. I just know this time is the worst it's been.
How often would you say these low stretches happen to you in a typical year?

I really couldn't tell you. Like I was saying, it's mostly just been this past year that I've even noticed them happening. Before that... well, I don't remember having years like this. So I don't really have a typical number to give you. They just sort of come and go.
How many times have you felt this low in the past year before your daughter left?

Doc, I really just don't know. I didn't count them. Like I've been saying, it was just off and on during those months before she moved out. I wish I could give you a specific number, but I just don't have one to give.
How many episodes of feeling low like this have you had in your entire life?

Look, doc, it's like I've been saying... I really just don't have a number for you. Over my whole life? I mean, I never really felt this bad until this past year. Before that, I just went to work and lived my life. So I can't give you a total count. I honestly just don't know.
Have you had more than two episodes of feeling low like this in the past year?
I don't know if it was more than two. I really couldn't say for sure. Like I said, it was just off and on. I didn't keep track of if it was two times, or three times, or what. It just happened.
